title: Context bundle, version 2
description: The published output contract. This file is the single source: the closed sets below are asserted against the code by BundleSchemaConformanceTest, so a kind, a lever or a diagnostic type added in one place and not the other fails the build. See ADR-A024 for the compatibility policy.

bundle_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change: a removal, a rename, or a change of nesting. Adding a field, an assertion kind or a diagnostic type is additive and does not bump it (ADR-A024).

run.description: What produced this bundle, so two bundles can be compared knowingly. Nothing here is observed from the environment: no clock, no hostname, no process (P8, P9).

engine_version.description: Declared constant, bumped with the release.

policy_version.description: Declared constant covering LeverPolicy, ItemPriority and PremiseCatalogue. Guarded: a test hashes those classes and fails when they move without this value moving.

framework_table_version.description: Derived from the framework naming table's own content, not declared.

budget_tokens.description: Echoes --budget. Moved here from the root in v2.

diff_sha.description: Digest of the diff bytes handed in.

repo_sha.description: Supplied by the caller through --repo-sha; null when it was not given. The tool cannot read it: git rev-parse needs a subprocess (P9), and .git is a file rather than a directory in the detached worktree ADR-A022's harness uses. Null is emitted explicitly rather than the key omitted.

used_tokens.description: The sum of items[].tokens, and of nothing else. Diagnostics are excluded by design (freeze review L2).

assertions.description: Every claim the diff makes, stated once. The reason lives here, not on each item (P5, ADR-A024).

items.description: The evidence gathered, in the fixed order at $defs/kindOrder, then by provenance.path, then by provenance.member. Every item names an assertion this bundle carries; an orphan is rejected before serialisation.

diagnostics.description: A machine-readable MIRROR of stderr, never a relocation: stderr still carries every line byte for byte, because a harness uses it to tell 'searched, found none' from 'never searched' (freeze review 05). Empty rather than absent. Carries no tokens.

dropped.description: Every budget drop, with the reason the item was included. Empty rather than absent when nothing was dropped (P7).

kindOrder.description: The fixed item ordering. Asserted equal to BundleAssembler::KIND_ORDER by the conformance test — this array is the source, the constant is the copy.

id.description: Derived from kind, subject, origin path and first line — the same tuple extraction de-duplicates on — so it is stable across runs (P8).

kind.description: Closed set. Asserted equal to AssertionKind's cases by the conformance test.

subject.description: The extractor's own structured datum, never parsed from the reason. Its meaning is fixed per kind: a member name for changed_signature and changed_return_contract; a fully-qualified class or member for named_reference; a symbol for same_file_symbol_absence and same_file_reference; a catalogue identifier for unverifiable_premise.

reason.description: Required. An assertion without one does not enter the bundle (P5).

origin.description: Where in the diff the claim arose. A path and a span only: an assertion has no origin member, so none is claimed.

assertion_id.description: Must match an id in assertions[]. Enforced in the domain, not merely documented.

lever.description: Closed set. Asserted equal to Lever's cases by the conformance test.

member.description: OPTIONAL, and absent rather than null when it does not apply. Present when the slice is a member: the enclosing member, a named reference's declaration, a model or enum surface, and a flagged item whose assertion names a member. Absent for a file's use block, which has no member name, for a flagged premise, which names a premise rather than a member (ADR-A009), and for every reverse-caller call site, because a call site is a line and not a member.

payload.description: Fetched: the minimal source slice (ADR-A005). Flagged: the assumption sentence and nothing else.

type.description: Closed set. Adding a mirrored diagnostic is additive and requires editing this enum — that edit is the point.

assertion_id.description: The assertion this concerns, or an empty string when it belongs to the run rather than to any one claim.

detail.description: The facts the stderr line renders as prose, as values.

reason.description: The reason the item was included in the first place, taken from its assertion.
